title: Professional Tax — State Legislation (demo excerpt)
authority: State Finance / Commercial Tax Department (varies by state; not levied in all states)

sections.content: Professional Tax is levied by some states (e.g. Maharashtra, Karnataka, West Bengal) and not others (e.g. Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh), with state-specific salary slabs and no single central regulator. This system does not yet have verified per-state slab data loaded, so the deterministic Rules Engine marks this obligation as requiring manual review when a business has employees, rather than asserting an unverified slab. This is a system-generated summary, not verbatim statute text.
